'''initiate/start or terminate/stop image scanning process'''
import nanosurf
import time

#load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()
application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

# Start scan
# scan.StartFrameDown() #Scanning from up to down or top to bottom

#scan.stop() #stop sacn

while scanning:
        print("Scanning in progress... Remaining lines:",(scan.Lines-scan.Currentline))
        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf
import time

#load application

application = spm.application
scan = application.Scan

        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm

import nanosurf, time, os, datetime, sys

# Initialize AFM
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
app = spm.application
scan = app.Scan

# Set scan area to 10 µm x 10 µm
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6
# Use reasonable resolution
scan.Points = 256
scan.Lines = 256
# Center position (optional, keep at 0)
scan.CenterPosX = 0.0
scan.CenterPosY = 0.0

print(f"Configured scan: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} µm x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm, {scan.Points}x{scan.Lines}")

# Start scan (upward direction)
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to finish
while getattr(scan, 'IsScanning', False):
    # Some APIs expose IsScanning property
    remaining = getattr(scan, 'Lines', 0) - getattr(scan, 'CurrentLine', 0)
    print(f"Scanning... lines remaining: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(2)
print("Scan completed.")

# Cleanup
del spm

import nanosurf
import time

application = spm.application

        time.sleep(3)
        scanning = scan.IsScanning
print("Scanning finished")
del spm
